candidates.title: Valuing maintenance strategies for fusion plants as part of a future electricity grid
candidates.notes: Accessible HTML version. Contains $1.74/MWh gross variable O&M ($2.07/MWh net). Models blanket replacement costs as $0–$500M/GWgross sensitivity parameter. Treats FO&M as comparative parameter rather than empirical dataset, but provides O&M cost anchor and maintenance scheduling framework.
